derivationNotes: Endpoint paths under /api/judge/ are assigned by this contract; method+prefix convention from POST /api/llama/propose.
LIMIT_TAMPER surfaces as 422 STATE_SNAPSHOT_MISMATCH: the failure-test row names one code for limit and state overrides.
Semantic refusals (schema, physics, tamper-verify) ride HTTP 200 with coded bodies; 422 is reserved for caller-tamper and latch trips.
The READY <port> stdout line is a clock-interface requirement assigned here; E4 prints it when listening.
No per-phase sub-bounds are sourced; only Gate A 60,000 ms binds, the clock records the rest.
The one-correction latch is keyed by proposal id; the clock uses a distinct proposal id per run.
